carlos-cs: Heads up — FrostBank just escalated. They ran the same rerank payload before/after our model swap and are seeing rank order changes and score deltas (~0.12 on top item). Customer blocked the release.

carlos-cs: Minimal repro I have:
```json
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json

{
  \"query\": \"wireless router \",
  \"candidates\": [\"TP-Link Archer A7\", \"Netgear R6700\", \"ASUS RT-AC66U\"]
}
```

carlos-cs: Before (model rerank-v1.9.2): top score 0.87 for TP-Link. After (rerank-v2.0.0): top score 0.74 and ordering changed. No errors/5xx in the responses, just different numbers. Customer attached their logs and is asking what changed.

dmitri-ml: @carlos-cs thanks for the repro. Can you paste the exact model tag + commit hash used in the swap? Also need the raw request payload (including spacing/hidden chars) — tokenization differences are often sneaky.

carlos-cs: Model tag rolled: rerank-v2.0.0 (deployed 2310000300). Previous: rerank-v1.9.2 (deployed 2309005000). I ran `curl` locally and included the raw body (no trimming). Reproducer attached above.

alyssa: Quick Q — is FrostBank using any custom normalization on their side (lowercasing/whitespace stripping) or sending weird control chars? We had a similar-looking issue where ZWSP changed token alignments.

carlos-cs: They say they send the same payload server-side, and we confirmed identical bytes on their end. I also tested from my laptop with same bytes.

eve-eng: Rollout note: we also pushed runtime kernel update to the quantized path at 2310000200 (low-risk perf patch). Could affect logits at tail precision.

ben-prod: Customer is getting anxious. Can we canary rollback their tenant to v1.9.2 while we investigate? If deterministic, rollback should resolve immediately. :grimacing:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Completed canary rollout: frostbank-namespace pinned to rerank-v1.9.2 at 2310000800 by ben-prod.

dmitri-ml: Good. For repro I'm going to ask for two exact response dumps (pre-swap and post-swap) with the model logits for each candidate. Also please run tokenization check:
```bash
python -c \"from tokenizer import t; print(t.encode(\"wireless router \"))\"
```
I want to diff token IDs between the runs. If tokens differ, that explains score drift. If tokens are identical, we look at kernel changes / quantization rounding.

carlos-cs: Pasting two response snippets (sanitized):
-- pre-swap --
{
  \"scores\": [0.87, 0.51, 0.46],
  \"order\": [\"TP-Link Archer A7\", \"Netgear R6700\", \"ASUS RT-AC66U\"]
}
-- post-swap --
{
  \"scores\": [0.74, 0.76, 0.49],
  \"order\": [\"Netgear R6700\", \"TP-Link Archer A7\", \"ASUS RT-AC66U\"]
}

dmitri-ml: Interesting — the middle candidate jumped. If tokenization same, my hypothesis is quantization kernel change introduced small logit perturbations that push near-border items over the threshold.

alyssa: Could also be routing to a different model shard (not identical weights)? Any checksum on the model file we can compare?

eve-eng: We have model artifact checksum records. I'll fetch the SHA256 for both artifacts and post here.

eve-eng: SHA256(rerank-v1.9.2) = fa12...9c3
SHA256(rerank-v2.0.0) = fa12...9c3

dmitri-ml: Checksums match — same weights. That pushes us to runtime difference. What changed in quantized execution? @eve-eng you mentioned kernel update, can you link the kernel PR?

eve-eng: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/412 — small change to fused-attn fp16->int8 path. It changed rounding heuristics in a hotpath.

dmitri-ml: OK that aligns. Quantization rounding tweak can shift logits by ~1e-1 in edge cases. Next steps:
- Re-run deterministic reproducer on both runtimes (old kernel vs new kernel) using pinned artifact and identical inputs.
- If reproduces: revert rounding or provide per-tenant runtime pinning.
- Notify FrostBank and offer pinned rollback (done by @ben-prod).

ben-prod: Revert already pinned for FrostBank. I'll keep them updated.

carlos-cs: Customer confirmed pinned tenant now sees previous ordering. They're satisfied for now but want a detailed RCA and a timeline for permanent fix.

dmitri-ml: I'll prepare an RCA: cause = kernel rounding change in quantized path; impact = small logit shifts causing rerank sensitivity for borderline candidates; remediation = revert rounding change or add stability tests in our model-onboarding evals.

eve-eng: I'll open a hotfix PR to add a config flag to toggle the new rounding and run long-running stability evals.

carlos-cs: Thanks everyone. Action items:
- dmitri-ml: RCA + regtest within 48h
- eve-eng: hotfix flag + eval run started
- ben-prod: customer comms + keep frostbank pinned until RC verified

ben-prod: I'll send the comms now. :+1:

infra-bot: incident-bot: Ticket #INC-2310001 created (rerank-score-regression-frostbank). Assigned: dmitri-ml, eve-eng, ben-prod.

carlos-cs: Closing thread for now — will reopen if customer sees variance after verification. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
